analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Below SMA100 ($0.20)/SMA200 ($0.24) — Maintaining mid-to-long-term trend weakness.
· 52-week position (6.1%) + Current price range is historically low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.7→64.5) + Exiting oversold and entering neutral zone + Interpreted as upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0006→0.0019) + Diagnosed as improving + Confirmed as a trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band $0.17) + Bandwidth of 15.16% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) + Based on 5-day low and Pivot S1.
· Swing resistance ($0.19) + Expectation of further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Interpreted as a recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.47x) + Increased confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Buy entry condition met upon confirmation of support at the 5-day low.
